rules.ci: 95% percentile bootstrap over photos; paired differences resample photos jointly (candidate minus reference)
rules.d11: candidate error rate <= reference + 2% (point estimate; paired CI shown); mono precision >= 0.98
rules.error_rate: share of photos with >= 1 wrong or invented fact, or no caption at all (a blocked or invalid photo counts as an error and as usefulness 1; it adds nothing to the wrong/invented/missing means)
rules.structured: scored against the Opus reference where its confidence is high or medium
